name: Pigment Liner Fineliner Set, Black, 8 Pens in Assorted Tip Sizes
bestUse: Best for captions, dates and fine details
descriptionOriginal: A box of eight black fineliners with pigment ink and a range of tip widths, from very fine to broad.
whyWeLikeIt: If you want more tip sizes, a box of eight runs from very fine to broad, so one set covers captions, headings and outlines. Staedtler describes the ink as waterproof on paper.
limitations: Black only, so this is not a colour set. Waterproof is the maker's claim for writing on paper; as with most pens, try it on a glossy sticker before committing a page.
qualityNote: Customers say it is among their favourites and works well with watercolour. No concerns seen when checked.
